options.orbit: Threshold, then a central void. You pass between two objects and a screen just inside the door, then circle one hero object standing alone in a large empty void ringed by six small objects. Product stations sit at the four outer corners, outside the loop. The pay desk closes the loop at the back. Size: default 20 x 16 m.
options.field: One open low field. A floor strip leads from the door to a single large hero object; four sculptural stations hold the product in a loose ring around it, and the route wanders between them to the pay at the back right. Nothing but the hero is tall. Size: default 16 x 12 m.
options.chamber: A room inside the room. A walled chamber with two side openings stands in the middle; three low monoliths inside it carry the product; two blocks break through the chamber walls. The route enters the chamber, circles the monoliths and leaves. There is no single hero: the chamber is the event. Size: default 18 x 12 m.
options.ritual: A small ritual room. Shelf walls wrap the left, right and back; one object at the centre is where you pause first; a counter sits at the back. The route circles the centre, then follows the shelves. Size: default 12 x 10 m.

reply.title: Submerged Resonance
reply.subtitle: A 1970s pool re-imagined through refracted light and brass geometry.
reply.line: You navigate an empty aquatic landscape where the memory of water is preserved in shimmering aluminum ripples and deep, silent basins.
reply.synopsis: You enter through the gap between polished concrete diving pillars, passing through a veil of aluminum cable curtains that mimic the fluidity of water. As you step into the deep end, you walk across white glossy surfaces that ground your movement within the hollow architecture of the basin. The central brass pool structure acts as a focal point, catching refracted light that plays across the floor like sunlight hitting a moving surface. You eventually reach the locker room desk at the rear, completing a journey that transforms a nostalgic sport facility into a contemplative stage for eyewear.
reply.quote: The absence of water creates a space where light itself becomes the fluid medium of the architecture.

why.meaning: The narrow gap between pillars forces you to abandon the outside world and enter the suspended reality of the pool.
Maintaining a respectful distance from the brass basin allows you to appreciate its sculptural form as a primary architectural anchor.
Turning away from the central void to reach the launch pads encourages you to interact with the products in a quiet, isolated frame.
The lime plaster desk provides a tactile, grounded endpoint that signifies the completion of your journey through the empty pool.
